sources.title: CloseHandle function
sources.bounded_paraphrase: Failure returns zero; GetLastError provides extended information. Invalid or pseudo handles cause an exception when the application runs under a debugger.

sources.title: GetModuleHandleA function
sources.bounded_paraphrase: A NULL name requests the calling executable's module handle. This API does not increment the module reference count.

sources.title: Debugger Exception Handling
sources.bounded_paraphrase: First chance precedes the process handler search. Last chance follows failure to find a handler; declining to handle that event causes termination. A handled disposition restores machine state and resumes execution.
